description: Build your kitchen on a foundation of strength with Innokit’s stainless steel joinery framework. Crafted from 304 food-grade stainless steel, our framework is rust-proof, termite-proof, and free of harmful chemicals. The precision tenon-and-mortise structure ensures durability, easy installation, and a perfect fit for custom cabinetry—delivering a high-end, eco-friendly solution built to last.
name: Joinery Framework
